tasks.label: cmake-configure
args: $vswhere = Join-Path ([Environment]::GetFolderPath('ProgramFilesX86')) 'Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe'; $vs = & $vswhere -latest -products * -requires Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.Tools.x86.x64 -property installationPath; if (-not $vs) { throw 'MSVC toolchain not found. Install Visual Studio C++ workload.' }; $vcvars = Join-Path $vs 'VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat'; if (-not (Test-Path $vcvars)) { throw "vcvars64.bat not found: $vcvars" }; $vcvars = (New-Object -ComObject Scripting.FileSystemObject).GetFile($vcvars).ShortPath; $cmd = 'call ' + $vcvars + ' >nul && set'; $envLines = & cmd.exe /d /c $cmd; foreach ($line in $envLines) { $m = [regex]::Match($line, '^([^=]+)=(.*)$'); if ($m.Success) { [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($m.Groups[1].Value, $m.Groups[2].Value, 'Process') } }; $preset = if (Test-Path 'CMakeUserPresets.json') { 'local-release' } else { 'windows-msvc-release' }; if ($preset -eq 'windows-msvc-release' -and -not $env:OPTIX_ROOT) { throw 'OPTIX_ROOT is not set. Set it or create CMakeUserPresets.json from CMakeUserPresets.json.example.' }; cmake --preset $preset; exit $LASTEXITCODE

Install Visual Studio C++ workload.' }; $vcvars = Join-Path $vs 'VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat'; if (-not (Test-Path $vcvars)) { throw "vcvars64.bat not found: $vcvars" }; $vcvars = (New-Object -ComObject Scripting.FileSystemObject).GetFile($vcvars).ShortPath; $cmd = 'call ' + $vcvars + ' >nul && set'; $envLines = & cmd.exe /d /c $cmd; foreach ($line in $envLines) { $m = [regex]::Match($line, '^([^=]+)=(.*)$'); if ($m.Success) { [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($m.Groups[1].Value, $m.Groups[2].Value, 'Process') } }; $preset = if (Test-Path 'CMakeUserPresets.json') { 'local-release' } else { 'windows-msvc-release' }; cmake --build --preset $preset; exit $LASTEXITCODE
